start.title: Improve {agent}
start.description: Each candidate harness is tried on this task in isolation. Nothing changes until a better harness is chosen, and wider changes wait for your approval.

start.domainPlaceholder: e.g. data/reports (groups lessons in the library)

isolationHint.files: Each attempt gets an empty scratch directory with copies of the input files.
isolationHint.git: Each attempt gets its own worktree of the repository at a fixed commit. Your working copy is never touched.

start.deliverablesPlaceholder: One path per line, e.g. report.md

start.useExperiences: Give the editors relevant lessons from the library

settings.title: Harness Evolution
settings.description: Let agents improve their own harness (instructions, guardrails, memory, tool guidance, skills, subagents, tool rules) by trying candidates on real tasks in isolation and keeping only what the evidence supports.
settings.enabledDescription: Off by default. Nothing runs, and no option below applies, until this is on.

startModeDescription.disabled: No runs start, even by hand.
startModeDescription.manual: Only when you start one from an agent's Evolution page.
startModeDescription.failure-triggered: Also offered under a turn that failed through the agent's own conduct.
startModeDescription.background: Also queued automatically after such a failure, and started by an hourly sweep within the limits below.

settings.offHint: Probes never touch your workspace, side effects are blocked or simulated, and changes beyond one task always wait for your approval.
settings.defaultModeDescription: Parallel tries independent edits side by side; sequential builds each round on the last.
settings.defaultKDescription: Candidates per stage. A run does 4k rollouts and 3k editor sessions.

editorChannelDescription.auto: A single structured proposal when the evidence fits in one prompt; an agent session over the evidence files when it does not.
editorChannelDescription.agentic: Editors work through the evidence files as an agent session.
editorChannelDescription.structured: Editors return one structured proposal from the evidence they are given inline.

settings.useExperiencesDescription: Give editors the most relevant lessons from earlier runs.
settings.autoAdoptDescription: Applies only to task and conversation scope. Workspace and global changes always ask.
settings.budgetDescription: A run stops at the first ceiling it reaches. Each run can lower these.

maxCostUsd.label: Cost (USD)
maxCostUsd.description: Spending across rollouts and model calls.

maxTokens.label: Tokens
maxTokens.description: Input plus output tokens across the run.

maxModelCalls.label: Model calls
maxModelCalls.description: Editor, composer, selection and reflection calls.

maxWallTimeMs.label: Time (minutes)
maxWallTimeMs.description: Wall-clock time from start to decision.

maxIterations.label: Iterations
maxIterations.description: The largest k a run may use.

maxCandidates.label: Candidates
maxCandidates.description: Candidate harnesses proposed across the run (2k).

maxParallelRuns.label: Parallel work
maxParallelRuns.description: Rollouts and editor sessions running at once.

maxTurnsPerRollout.label: Turns per rollout
maxTurnsPerRollout.description: Agent turns one attempt may take.

settings.modelsDescription: Which model plays each role. Unset roles use the agent's own model.

roleDescription.executor: Runs the agent on the task in every rollout.
roleDescription.editor: Proposes harness edits from the evidence.
roleDescription.composer: Combines the best edits into one harness.
roleDescription.selector: Judges the finalists when the checks cannot decide.
roleDescription.reflector: Attributes what helped and writes the lesson.

settings.invalidModel: No configured provider offers this model.
settings.probeDescription: MCP servers you trust to be read-only during probes. Calls to any other server are blocked.
settings.cooldownDescription: After an automatic run or a dismissed offer, wait this long before offering or queuing another for the same agent.
settings.backgroundIntervalDescription: Least time between background runs being started.
settings.backgroundRunsDescription: Most background runs in flight at once.
settings.experienceCapDescription: The weakest lessons are evicted beyond this.
